simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: בֵּית הָעֵמֶק (Bêyth hâ-ʻÊmeq) means Beth-ha-Emek , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 27.

definitions.full: H1025. Beth Haemeq הָעֵ֫מֶק בֵּית proper name, of a location on border of Asher ( valley-house ) Josh 19:27 . Survey i. 145 compare `Amka , 7 miles northeast of Akko (but see Rob BR iii. 103, 108 ).
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and 6010 with the article interposed; house of the valley;
